word-search.intro: Potu si‘i ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e tohi lahi mo e kupu si‘i pe nai, ʻoku ʻalu kotoa ʻi he fakafeituʻu pe lalo. Tā ʻa e tohi ʻuluaki ʻo e kupu, pea tā ʻa e tohi hope. Fiemaʻu ke taʻi ʻi he pepa? Lolomi ha puzzle foʻou ʻi ha tā pe.
howTo: Fili ha kaveinga mo e lahi ʻo e potu.
Vakai ki he lisi ʻo e kupu. ʻOku tohi ʻa e kupu fakafeituʻu (mei he taha ki he taha) pe lalo (mei ʻolunga ki lalo).
Tā ʻa e tohi ʻuluaki ʻo e kupu, pea tā ʻa e tohi hope.
Ko e kupu kuo ʻilo‘i ʻoku ʻai ke mā‘oluolu, pea ʻoku tā ʻi he lisi.
Tā ʻa “Lolomi e puzzle ni” ke taʻi ʻi he pepa mo e penisolo pe mākā.
tips: Tā ki ha kupu ʻi he lisi, pea vakai ki hono tohi ʻuluaki fakataha.
ʻI he pepa, ʻoku faingofua ange ke ʻai ha mākā lanu ke fakamāmaʻi ha kupu.
Talanoa ki he ngaahi kupu ʻo e kaveinga. Ko e kupu ʻo e fua ʻoku ʻai ke fakamanatu ki he tanu, kuki pe maketi.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha taimi pe sikoa?
faq.a: Ikai. ʻOku ʻikai ha taimi, ha sikoa, ha kaunga ngaahi fakahoko pe ha tō. ʻE lava ke ke tuku ʻi ha taimi pe, pea ko e tuku ʻi he vaha‘a ko ha founga lelei ia ke fakaʻiku ai.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u lolomi ʻa e faʻalo kupu?
faq.a: ʻIo. Tā ʻa “Lolomi e puzzle ni” ke lolomi ʻa e kupu ʻoku ʻi he taimi ni ʻi he tohi lahi, mo e lisi ʻo e kupu ʻi lalo. ʻOku kehe ʻa e puzzle kotoa ʻi he taimi kotoa.

faq.q: ʻOku koloa ia, pea ʻoku fiemaʻu ke ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ʻoku koloa ia, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻakaunti, fakahingoa pe ha taʻa. ʻE ngāue ʻi he kemi ʻi he telefoni, tapolo pe kompiuta.

coloring.name: Ngaahi peesi lanu
coloring.seoTitle: Ngaahi Peesi Lanu ki he Kakai Motua ʻoku Maʻu ʻa e Mahaki ʻo e ʻAtamai (ʻOku ʻikai totongi)
coloring.description: Ngaahi peesi lanu faingofua ki he kakai motua ʻoku ʻi ai ha potu lahi: tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ʻa e konga ʻo e tāʻā. ʻOku ʻikai ha lanu hala, pea ʻe lava ke lolomi ʻa e peesi kotoa ʻoku ʻikai totongi.
coloring.short: Tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ʻa e konga ʻo e tāʻā. ʻE lava foki ke lolomi ʻa e peesi.
coloring.intro: Peesi ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi tāʻā lahi mo faingofua: ko e fuá ʻi he ipu, ko e fale, ko e tī ʻoku ʻi ha ipu, ko e pepe, mo e vaka lauʻi. Tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ha konga ʻo e tāʻā ke fakakīʻi ia. ʻOku ʻikai ha lanu hala.
howTo: Fili ha peesi.
Tā ha lanu. ʻOku tohi ʻa e hingoa ʻo e lanu ʻi he lanu ko iá.
Tā ha konga ʻo e tāʻā ke fakakīʻi ia ʻaki e lanu ko iá.
Ke liliu hoʻo loto ʻi ha taimi pe, fakakīʻi ʻa e konga ko iá ʻi ha lanu kehe.
Tā ʻa “Lolomi e peesi ni” ke maʻu ha peesi mataʻa ke lanu ʻaki ʻa e penisolo pe mākā.
tips: ʻOku talia ʻa e ngaahi ʻakau lanu pulu mo e la lanu lanu. Ko e fiefia ʻi he lanu ʻoku fiemaʻu, ʻikai ko e totonu.
Ke ʻikai faingata‘a ke fili, ʻe lelei ke ʻai ha lanu ʻe ua ke fili, ʻikai ha seti kotoa.
Ko e peesi kuo lolomi ʻoku lelei ke fakatokaʻi mo e penisolo mafana pe mākā lahi, ʻoku faingofua ange ke puke.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha taimi pe sikoa?
faq.a: Ikai. ʻOku ʻikai ha taimi, ha sikoa, ha kaunga ngaahi fakahoko pe ha tō. ʻE lava ke ke tuku ʻi ha taimi pe, pea ko e tuku ʻi he vaha‘a ko ha founga lelei ia ke fakaʻiku ai.

faq.q: ʻOku fakatamasiʻi ʻa e ngaahi peesi ni?
faq.a: ʻOku ʻikai. Kuo tā ʻa e ngaahi me‘a faingofua mo mā‘oluolu ʻikai ko e ngaahi talatala, ko ia ʻoku lelei ai ki he kakai motua. Ko e ngaahi tāʻā lahi ʻoku faingofua ke tā ʻaki e lanu, ʻikai ko e fakatamasiʻi.

faq.q: ʻOku koloa ia, pea ʻoku fiemaʻu ke ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ʻoku koloa ia, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻakaunti, fakahingoa pe ha taʻa. ʻE ngāue ʻi he kemi ʻi he telefoni, tapolo pe kompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Ngaahi kāati talanoa
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Ngaahi Kupu Kamata Talanoa ki he Mahaki ʻo e ʻAtamai: Ngaahi Kāati Tāʻā
conversation-cards.description: Ngaahi kāati tāʻā mo e ngaahi fakaafe mā‘oluolu ki he talanoa ki he kakai ʻoku maʻu ʻa e mahaki ʻo e ʻatamai: ʻikai ha fehuʻi ʻo hangē ko ha ʻekisāmi, ʻikai ha tali totonu. Ngāue ʻi he sikirini pe lolomi ʻa e seti kotoa.
conversation-cards.short: Kāati tāʻā mo e ngaahi fehuʻi mā‘oluolu. ʻIkai ha fehuʻi ki he fakamanatu.
conversation-cards.intro: Ko e kāati kotoa ʻoku ʻi ai ha tāʻā ʻoku ʻilo, mo ha fakaafe ke talanoa, hangē ko “Ko e hā ʻa e ʻea ʻoku ke ʻofa ʻaupito ki ai?” ʻOku ʻikai ha tali totonu pe ko e maʻu ke manatu. Fili ha kaveinga pe fakatafeholo ʻa e kāati kotoa.
howTo: Fili ha kaveinga, pe tuʻu ki he “Kāati kotoa”.
Lau ʻa e fehuʻi ʻi he leo lahi, pea vakai ki he tāʻā fakataha.
Fanongo, fakahā hoʻo tali ʻoku, pea tuku ke ʻalu ʻa e talanoa.
Tā ʻa “Kāati hoko” ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke loto ai, pe tuʻu ʻi he kāati ko ia ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke loto ai.
Tā ʻa “Lolomi kāati kotoa” ke maʻu ha seti pepa ke tipuʻi.
tips: Tali foki ʻa e fehuʻi ʻe koe. ʻOku hangē ko ha talanoa, ʻikai ko ha fakatotolo.
Muimui ʻi he talanoa, ʻikai ʻa e faktaʻ. Kapau ʻoku liliu ʻa e fakamatala, ʻoku ʻikai ha palopalema.
Kapau ʻoku ʻai ʻe ha kāati ha ongo mamahi, ʻoku ʻai ke talia ʻa e ongo ko iá mo e liliu mā‘oluolu ki ha kāati kehe.

faq.q: Ko e hā ʻoku ʻikai ai ha fehuʻi “ʻOku ke manatu…?”
faq.a: Ko e ngaahi fehuʻi ʻoku fakatotolo ki he fakamanatu ʻoku lava ke hangē ko ha ʻekisāmi, ʻo ʻai ai ha maʻuʻā. Ko e ngaahi fakaafe mā‘oluolu hangē ko “Talanoa mai ki he…” ʻoku lava ke kau ai ha taha, ʻi he me‘a ʻoku ne manatu ai.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u lolomi ʻa e ngaahi kāati?
faq.a: ʻIo. “Lolomi ʻa e kāati kotoa” ʻoku lolomi ai ʻa e seti kotoa ʻi he tohi lahi, ʻe lahi ʻa e kāati ʻi he peesi kotoa, ʻoku lelei ke tipuʻi.

faq.q: ʻOku koloa ia, pea ʻoku fiemaʻu ke ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e koloa ia ʻe taʻetotongi, pea ʻikai ha akauni, lesisita pe download. ʻOku ngāue ia ʻi he web browser ʻi he telefoni, tapolete pe kompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Fakatatau ʻa e ngaahi ata
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Ngāue ha Taʻaʻi Fakatatau mei he Ngaahi Ata ʻo e Famili
photo-pairs.h1: Fakatatau ʻa e Ngaahi Ata: Fakatatau ʻa Ho Ngaahi Ata
photo-pairs.description: Liliu ho ngaahi ata famili ko ha taʻaʻi fakatatau fiemālie. Filifili ngaahi ata ʻe 2 ki he 6 ʻi ho meʻa fakamatala; ʻe nofo ia ʻi ho browser pea ʻikai ʻave ki ha feituʻu.
photo-pairs.short: Filifili ho ngaahi ata pea fakatatau ia. ʻIkai ʻave ha meʻa.
photo-pairs.players: 2 ha tangata, ʻi he taha mo e taha
photo-pairs.intro: Filifili ngaahi ata ʻe ua ki he ono mei ho telefoni, tapolete pe kompiuta, pea ʻe hoko ia ko ha taʻaʻi fakatatau mo e ngaahi ata lalahi mo ʻaonga ke mamata ki ai. ʻE ʻikai ʻave, tauhi pe fakafaingofua ʻa e ngaahi ata ni; ʻe hā pē ia ʻi loto ʻi he peesi ni, pea ʻe mole ia ʻi ho tāpuni ʻo e peesi.
howTo: Tuʻu ʻo “Filifili ngaahi ata” pea filifili ngaahi ata ʻe ua ki he ono.
Ko e ata taki taha ʻe hā ʻo ua. Tuʻu ʻe taha, pea tuʻu ʻa ʻene tatau.
Lea ki he ata taki taha ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke ʻilo ai ia.
ʻI he faʻa ngata ʻa koe, tāpuni ʻa e peesi pe tuʻu ʻo “Toʻo ʻa e ngaahi ata”. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe tauhi.
tips: Filifili ngaahi ata mahino ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku fiefia mo ʻiloa: ʻulu ʻi, ngoue, feituʻu ʻoku ʻofa ki ai, ʻaho malanga.
Ko e ngaahi ata ʻo e feituʻu mo e koloa ʻe faingofua ange ʻi he kanokano, pea ʻe ʻikai ai ha fakamamafa ke tala ʻaki ha hingoa.
Tuku ngaahi ata ʻo e kau tangata kuo mate ʻi tuʻa, kapau ʻe lava ke fakamamafa ʻa e loto ʻi ai, neongo kapau ʻoku ke ʻiloa ʻe fakafiemālie ia.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻave ʻa ho ngaahi ata ki ha feituʻu?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻE lau ʻe he peesi ʻa e ngaahi ata ʻaho ʻoku ke filifili ai ʻi ho browser pea hā ia ʻi ho sikirini. ʻOku ʻikai ʻave ki kimautolu pe ki ha taha kehe, pea ʻe mole ʻi ho tāpuni pe toe hiki ʻa e peesi.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha taimi pe ngaahi tohi?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ha taimi, tohi, kauʻi ʻo e ngaahi kaveinga, pe hē. ʻE lava ke ke tuku ʻi ha taimi ʻo ʻikai ha ʻuhinga, pea ko e tuku ʻi he vaʻe ʻo e ngāue ko ha founga lelei ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u tauhi ʻa e kēmi ki he taimi kehe?
faq.a: ʻIkai ʻi he browser, ʻi he ʻuhinga ʻo e fakatotoló, koeʻuhí ke ʻikai tauhi ha meʻa taʻetokoni. Ko e ʻapi Golden Moments ki he iPhone mo e iPad ʻe lava ke ne tauhi ha kopi ʻo ha ngaahi ata filifili ʻi ho meʻa fakamatala.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo ʻaki e ngaahi ata
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo ʻaki e Ngaahi Ata ma e Kau Mātuʻa ʻoku Mahaki ʻi he Fakamanatu: ʻOku Lava ke Paʻi
picture-bingo.h1: Bingo ʻaki e Ngaahi Ata ma e Kulupu
picture-bingo.description: Bingo ʻaki e ngaahi ata ʻoku lava ke paʻi ʻaupito, ma e kau tokanga ki he fakamanatu mo e kulupu motuʻa, mo ha tokotaha ui ʻi he sikirini lalahi. Ngaahi ata lalahi mo e ngaahi hingoa, 9 pe 16 ngaahi sikuea, ʻikai fiema'u ke lau.
picture-bingo.short: Ngaahi kāati bingo ʻoku lava ke paʻi mo ha tokotaha ui ʻi he sikirini lalahi ma e kulupu.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo fakakalasi ʻaki e ngaahi ata ʻi he ʻuhinga ʻo e ngaahi namba, koeʻuhí ke ʻikai fiema'u ha taha ke lau ʻa e kupu iiki. Paʻi ha sete ʻo e ngaahi kāati ʻoku ʻikai tatau, pea ko e tokotaha ui ʻi he sikirini ʻe hā ai ʻa e ata taki taha lalahi ʻi he TV, laptop pe tapolete.
howTo: Filifili ngaahi sikuea ʻe 9 pe 16 ʻi he kāati taki taha mo e ʻuhinga ʻo e kau tokotaha.
Tuʻu ʻo “Paʻi ngaahi kāati”. ʻE ʻikai tatau ʻa e kāati taki taha.
Fakaʻā ʻa e tokotaha ui ʻi he sikirini lalahi. Tuʻu ʻo “Ata hoko mai” ke hā ai ʻa e ata taki taha mo ʻene hingoa.
Ko e kau tokotaha ʻe ʻufi ʻa e ata tatau ʻi honau kāati ʻaki ha pātone, ʻuhila pe maka.
Ko ia ʻoku kātoa ha laine, pe ko e kāati kotoa, ʻe fiefia ʻaki ha hiva. ʻOku ʻikai ha tokotaha hē ʻi he founga ni: kuo pe ke ʻoua ʻe tuku ha taha ʻo ʻikai ha laine.
tips: Ngaahi tokeni lalahi hangē ko e ngaahi tafa pe ngaahi fufu pulu. Ko e ngaahi kiʻi putoni ʻe faingataʻa ke toʻo.
Tala ʻa e hingoa ʻo e ata mo ha lea nounou ki ai: “Ko e vaka fefaʻuaki. Ko hai kuo ʻalu ʻi he vaka?”
Tuʻu ʻa e kau tokotaha ʻoku faingataʻa ʻenau mamata ofi ange ki he sikirini, pea fakatatau ʻa e tokoni mo e kau tokotaha ʻoku fiema'u ia.
Ngaahi sikuea ʻe 9 ʻoku lahi ia ki he kulupu lahi. Tauhi ʻa e fakatahaʻi ʻi he taimi ʻe 20 ki he 30 minite.

faq.q: Pehē ʻe fēfē ʻa e fai ʻo e bingo ʻaki e ngaahi ata ʻi ha feituʻu tokanga?
faq.a: Paʻi ha kāati ʻe taha ki he tokotaha taki taha, tuku ʻa e tokotaha ui ʻi he sikirini lalahi tahá ʻoku ʻi ai, pea ui ʻa e ngaahi ata ʻo fakatōmalie, mo lea ki he hingoa ʻo e taki taha. Ngāue ʻo ʻoua ʻe tuku ha taha ʻo ʻikai ha laine.

faq.q: ʻOku totongi ke paʻi?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e koloa ia ʻe taʻetotongi. Paʻi ʻa e ngaahi kāati ʻe fiemaʻu, ʻi he taimi ʻe fiemaʻu ai, ki he ngāue fakafāmili pe fakakulupu.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke fakafiefia ʻa e kau tokotaha ʻo ʻikai ke lau?
faq.a: ʻIo. Ko e sikuea taki taha ko ha ata lalahi, mo ʻene hingoa ʻi lalo ki he kau tokotaha ʻoku fiefia ki he lea.

calm-breathing.name: Mānava Filemu
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Ha Taimi Filemu ʻo e Mānava ma e Kau Mātuʻa mo e Kau Tokanga
calm-breathing.h1: Ha Taimi Filemu ʻo e Mānava
calm-breathing.description: Ha taimi mānava fiemālie mo filemu ke fakatahaʻi: ha kāutaha ʻoku tupu mo mamaʻa ʻi he ongo mānava ʻe ono. Ko koe ʻoku kamata, pea ʻe lava ke ke tuku ʻi ha taimi.
calm-breathing.short: Ha kāutaha ʻoku mānava ai. Kamata pe tuku ʻi ha taimi ʻoku ke loto ki ai.
calm-breathing.intro: ʻI he taimi lahi, ko e ngāue lelei taha ko ha taimi filemu. Tuʻu ʻo “Kamata”, pea mānava ʻi he taimi ʻoku tupu ai ʻa e kāutaha, mo ʻaʻaku ʻi he taimi ʻoku mamaʻa ai. Filifili ha vave pe ngingila ʻo e founga. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha faitoʻo, ka ko ha taimi fiemālie ke fakatahaʻi.
howTo: Nofo fiemālie ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻe taha.
Filifili ʻa e vave: ngingila pe fiemālie.
Tuʻu ʻo “Kamata”. Mānava ʻi he taimi ʻoku tupu ai ʻa e kāutaha, pea ʻaʻaku ʻi he taimi ʻoku mamaʻa ai.
ʻE tuku ia ʻi he taimi ʻe ono ʻo e mānava, pe tuʻu ʻo “Tuku” ʻi he taimi ʻoku loto ki ai.
tips: Fekumi ʻa e nima pe tuku ha nima ki he nima ʻo e tokotaha kapau ʻoku talitali lelei ia.
ʻOua ʻe fakamālohi. Kapau ʻe loto ia ke vakai pē, ko ia ʻoku lelei.
Kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha faingataʻa ʻi he mānava, mānava ʻo hangē ko e founga ʻi he ʻaho pea vakai pē ki he kāutaha. Fehuʻi ki ha foungamotuʻa ki ha ngaahi tokanga ʻo e mānava.

faq.q: Ko ha ngāue mānava faitoʻo ni?
faq.a: ʻIkai. Ko ha taimi filemu, faingofua, ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu, mo e kau fakataha. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha faitoʻo ki he manavahē pe ha mahaki ʻe taha. Talanoa mo ha foungamotuʻa ʻi he ngaahi tokanga ʻo e moʻui.

faq.q: ʻOku fetuʻutaki ʻa e kāutaha ʻo ʻikai ke u kamata ia?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ke fakanekeneka ha me'a ʻoua ke ke tōmui ʻi he Kamata, pea ʻe ngata ia hili ʻa e mānava ʻe ono pe ʻi ho tōmui ʻi he Taʻofi. Kapau kuo fakatonutonu ho fakamatala ke siʻisiʻi ʻa e nekeneka, ʻe liliu pē ʻa e ngaahi lea ka ʻe ʻikai ke tupu ʻa e tōʻā.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻikai ha totongi ia, pea ʻe fiemaʻu ke ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ʻoku ʻikai ha totongi, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha kaunga, fakahingoa pe download. ʻE ngāue ia ʻi he laka ʻi he initaneti ʻi he telefoni, tapaleti pe komipiuta.
